description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the FeaturesCreated class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It tests immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and input validation for FeaturesCreated objects.

classes.name: FeaturesCreatedTest

methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for FeaturesCreated using EqualsVerifier.

methods.description: Ensures that creating FeaturesCreated with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures

methods.description: Verifies that a FeaturesCreated instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON representation.
